01 · Services

Graphic design

Identities, print and digital assets that are recognisable at first glance.

I build identities and assets that are recognisable at first glance. Design is not a layer of decoration: it is a tool to make a message clearer, more credible and harder to ignore.

From a logo to a poster, from social posts to presentations, every piece is designed to work on its own and to hold together as a coherent system.

What you get

What you get

  • Visual identity: logo, variations, colours, typography, usage rules
  • Print: posters, flyers, brochures, business cards, roll-up banners
  • Digital design: posts, carousels, stories, banners, presentations
  • UI design: mockups, prototypes, dashboards
  • Art direction: framing, retouching, series consistency

Process

How we move forward.

  1. 01

    Brief

    We clarify the goal, the audience and what needs to change in perception.

  2. 02

    Research

    References, benchmarks, composition and typography tests.

  3. 03

    Direction

    One strong, argued direction, presented in its real context.

  4. 04

    Production

    Variations, finishing, files ready for print or web.
